caption: The drawing depicts a wooden vanity table with a marble top surface and an attached mirror. The mirror is oval and framed in intricately carved wood, with decorative scrollwork projecting outward at the top and sides. The marble top is white with subtle gray veining, set on a square wooden enclosure with rounded edges, featuring a single small drawer with a keyhole. The table is supported by a central turned wooden column, which transitions into three ornately curved legs branching outwards for stability. A slender vertical rod extends downward from beneath the marble top, on one side of the table. The wood throughout is depicted in natural brown hues, with a smooth, polished appearance, and the scene is rendered against a plain, light beige background.
title: Shaving Stand
